_comment: Model prices, in cost units per 1k tokens, keyed by the exact model id the provider reports (e.g. the value of AI_PROVIDER_MODEL). This file is DELIBERATELY EMPTY of prices: real prices are known only to the project owner and must never be invented or guessed. To activate the cost guard for a model, add an entry, e.g. "gpt-5.6-sol": 0.002. This file lives under config/ on purpose -- scripts/build_cloud_bundle.py copies config/ into the release bundle, whereas data/ is gitignored and never ships, so prices placed there would never reach production. An empty file means every model is unpriced; the quota guard then reports the cost as an unresolved operand (visible on the decision) rather than silently treating the model as free.
_how_to_verify: cd /d/LiuHao-AI-OS && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'D:/LiuHao-AI-OS');from src.ai.agent_factory import economy_inputs;print(economy_inputs('p','gpt-5.6-sol',1000,500))" -- it must print an estimated_cost key once a price is set for that model, and must NOT print one while the price is absent.
